description: Each identical processor core on the NITROX PX die implements several security and math algorithms, including ModEx (and RSA), ECC, 3DES, AES256, KASUMI, SHA1, SHA2, and MD5 (hash and HMAC). Performance ranges: 500Mbps to 2.5Gbps of encryption bandwidth; 4k to 17k RSA's; 6k to 25k DH operations per second. Accelerate IPSec, SSL, XML, and WLAN.
